description: This file is a shell script that functions as a test suite for the 'git mergetool' command. It includes setup steps, various test cases to verify the behavior of Git's merge tool functionality with different configurations and scenarios, such as handling of submodules, conflicts, custom commands, GUI options, and special cases like deleted files, crlf line endings, and resolution behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test case completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail; verifies failure.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a specified file.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Sets up a new Git repository.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns in files or command outputs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites, e.g., mktemp availability.
